summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Coke's water reticulation digital twin MVP. All core features are functional including real-time sensor simulation, AI integration with Claude Sonnet 4.5, interactive dashboard, and alert management.

resolved_issues.fix_applied: Fixed dictionary access in AI context generation

integration_issues.issue: AI responses may take 8-10 seconds to appear due to Claude API processing time
integration_issues.workaround: Responses do arrive, just need patience for AI processing

passed_tests: Dashboard loads with header showing Talbot logo and 'Live' indicator
Four metric cards display real-time values (Total Flow, Avg Pressure, Active Alerts, Sensors Online)
Process Flow Diagram displays with interactive sensor status dots (green/orange/red)
Sensor tooltips show on hover with instrument details
Instrumentation panel shows grid of sensor cards with real-time values
Anomaly Detection panel shows detected anomalies with confidence percentages (76%, 94%)
Active Alerts panel displays alerts with severity levels and acknowledge buttons
AI Agent panel accepts queries and returns responses using Claude Sonnet 4.5
Suggested queries in AI panel are clickable and populate input field
Real-time data updates every 5 seconds (verified flow rate changed from 351.03 to 359.59 L/min)
Alert acknowledgment working - alert count decreases after acknowledgment
GET /api/stats returns system statistics
GET /api/sensors/latest returns current sensor readings (10 instruments)
GET /api/alerts returns active alerts (24 active alerts found)
POST /api/alerts/:id/acknowledge marks alert as acknowledged
GET /api/anomalies returns detected anomalies
POST /api/ai/query with Claude Sonnet 4.5 returns AI responses
Dark control room aesthetic with proper color scheme (#0A0A0A background)
Sensor simulation generates realistic data with proper variance
Compliance monitoring for pH and chlorine levels
Leak detection and anomaly detection generates alerts with confidence scores
